title: QR Print: chained printing investigation
lede: Chained printing did not pass physical acceptance on this PT-D610BT. The helper keeps its verified per-label transport, recovery journal and Stop behavior. No additional content will be sent automatically.

stats.n: No change to the accepted application transport or layout.
Missing labels, continued blank waste or no completion.
Power-cycled; status-only readback confirmed no errors and idle phase zero.

sections.heading: Acknowledgement did not establish physical output
sections.note: After-only evidence from an isolated local protocol interface and actual Brother hardware. These are not application UI comparisons. Test QR payloads identify FB FX3 1; all rendering uses the approved exact Gotham/Medium Small bitmap. User observations, not green acknowledgements, decide acceptance.

shots.title: Revised A/B chain
shots.cap: Two type-1/no-error acknowledgements. The user received A and two blank strips; no B.

shots.title: Zero-raster final-feed attempt
shots.cap: No completion within 20 seconds. USB closed without replay. Manual Feed & Cut did not recover B or left an error.

shots.title: Normal initialization comparison
shots.cap: The first chained page timed out. D was never sent. The user received one blank strip and no printed label.

changes.was: Independent labels had accepted centering/scans, Stop and disconnect recovery, at the cost of one blank leader per label.
changes.now: That verified path stays unchanged. No chained mode, provisional completion claim or hidden feed was introduced.

changes.h: Investigation captured for the next safe attempt
changes.was: Final-feed and mixed-page D610 behavior were unverified.
changes.now: Failed wire sequences, source references, UI receipts and physical results are retained. A known-good exact-model capture must establish a reliable finish before implementation.

verification: Both first and second two-page probes received no-error type-1 acknowledgements, but failed the user’s physical count. They were rejected rather than recorded as completed application copies.
Zero-raster release timed out after 20 seconds; there was no software retry. The third probe timed out before its second page, so D was never sent.
The user power-cycled the Brother. Final status-only readback was type0, phaseType0, phaseNumber0, error bytes0; USB closed. No further print or feed commands were sent.

Prototype JavaScript syntax checks pass. The application renderer, transport, journal/domain/controller, server and defaults are unchanged; no app build or new application behavior is claimed for this investigation.
Necessary independent protocol review identified provisional acknowledgements, final-feed journaling and phase-number requirements for any future chain implementation.
notes: Chained printing remains unresolved. No lower-waste claim is made.
The current helper still produces one blank leader offcut per label. A verified exact-model chain/final-feed capture is required before trying more content commands.
The one-blank-raster Stop-release candidate was prepared but never executed, because two-page chaining did not pass.
All test receipts stay separate from real application history. No migration, commit, push or deployment.
